spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 The Three
 Channels
 of Influx

---


**¶1.
** There
 are three channels of
 spiritual influx that
 exist
 through every
 degree of the mind, from the lowest
 natural states to the highest celestial states
.


**¶2.** The
 first channel is
 the origin of all spiritual faculties in
 the interior states —
 those
 that
 exist
 throughout
 all
 the heav
ens of
 the mind. These faculties have been
 projected outward and bound into the natural
 mind below
; for the natural mind is the "
casting
 off,"
 the ou
termost truth
-covering and corporeal form of the
 spiritual faculties that d
well above
 in
 the interior states.

**¶
3.** For
 when
 the Divine,
 as
 the
 origin
 of all
 life
, formed
 the interior spiritual
 states, He separated from them their ou
termost natural forms and cast these down
 into the natural mind.


**¶4.** Thus
 the
 interior
 states consist of will and understanding in their
 living essence; but
 the external states consist of out
ward form
 and
 lif
eless shell
. Now
 as
 for
 this
:
 the Divine impressed the pattern of the
 interior fac
ulties upon their outermost natural correspond
ences —
 upon
 their
 dead
 forms
 in
 the natural mind — so that when the
 living essence is gathered from the fullness
 of natural experience, it can be entirely
 elevated to the interior through
 the connections that are fastened within
 those external
 forms. And through this,
 all life can be purified in
 that
 passage
.

**¶5.**
 However
, the fals
ity
 and evil that are separated out from
 the purified essence
 as
 it ascends to the interior will
 be
 cast downward through these same channels of
 influx and p
oured down and
 discharged into the lowest regions.


**¶6.** This
 is the first channel:
 from
 the spiritual
 fac
ulties of
 the interior
 states down
ward to their
 ou
termost natural forms
 in
 the external
 mind
;
 and from those
 out
ward forms up
ward again
 to the spiritual
 faculties of
 the interior states.

**¶
7.** The second channel is the
 one
 that desc
ends from the doc
trinal forms, the habitations of
 wisdom, and the communities
 of good that
 exist
 in the interior states, down
 to the five kinds of perception that grow
 in the natural mind. The living essence
 ascends from these perceptions into the
 doctrinal forms and communities of wisdom
;
 and life
 also
,
 with
 whatever
 the
 interior
 states release
, desc
ends to
 the
 perceptions through this
 same channel.

**¶8
.** And
 the third channel encompasses
 all the
 spiritual faculties and governing affections that
 dwell throughout
 the intermediate rational states, whose connections extend
 down
 from
 them
 to
 the five kinds of natural affection that
 cre
ep upon the external plane of the mind
, being bound
 to
 one another. Now
, the capacity and the
 living
 essence that are gathered from these natural aff
ections are
 dispersed among them in manifold forms
.
 The
 interior faculties draw them upward through
 the channels of influx.


**¶9.** The
 imp
urity also
 —
 the
 self
-love
, the mal
ice, and the w
rath — that are excessive
 in the interior
 fac
ulties are
 disch
arged down
ward through
 their
 several
 channels.
 They
 are poured out
 upon the rational
 faculty and upon
 all
 the remaining
 natural affections.
 When what
 is
 interior
 thus
 w
ashes
 its
 impurity
 and
 corruption
 and
 poison
 down upon the natural affections below
, in
 their
 turn these
 aff
ections become more
 inflamed with self
-love, wrath, and mal
ice against
 one another —
 through the action of their spiritual origins on
 high
.

**¶10.**
 Still
, observe
 the cycle
 of hereditary nature
!
 It has no direct
 connection
 ro
oted in the natural mind,
 but its origins are bound into the whole
 collective spiritual order. The
 cycle of hereditary nature,
 then
, receives life
 through the vitality that ascends from
 natural states through the channels of influx
 and through the intermediate rational states above
. It also draws life from those channels
 that convey upward to the rational
 and interior states above it
 —
 it
 draws life from that
 place
.

**¶11.**
 Observe:
 since
 the hered
itary cycle has no root in the natural
 mind, from where did inherited dispositions
 and hereditary tendencies find
 this
 dominion? They became rulers over the
 five kinds of natural affection and the
 five kinds of perception. Even
 though
 you
 have told
 us the
 hered
itary cycle has no root there
!
 For you
 said
 to us that
 every
 living
 element
,
 if
 it can be freed
 from the natural mind, is
 drawn up
ward by
 the interior faculties through a
 channel of influx.
 And yet
 we
 see that everything
 a
 person attains — whether it
 be
 abundance of good that comes into his possession
 or spiritual poverty that
 ac
crues to him, or
 his
 s
ickness and
 his
 wholeness — he
 att
ains it
 through inherited
 tend
encies and the particular hered
itary nature under which he was born.


**¶12.** Nevertheless
, what
 I
 declared
 to
 you — that
 the hereditary cycle has no root in
 the natural mind — I have told
 you rightly.
 It
 is established
 in
 its
 own
 position
.
 For
 when
 the Divine acting as spiritual power formed the
 interior states and the intermediate rational states,
 He bound their connections into the natural mind
 below — into the outermost forms
 that He
 had separated from them. Yet
 when He formed the hered
itary cycle, He did not bind its
 root into the natural mind;
 rather, He bound the root of the
 hereditary cycle to the collective evil of
 the unre
generate proprium.

**
¶13.** And
 when Divine
 Truth was revealed
,
 it manif
ested its
 form and
 purified and
 drew forth wisdom from all the interior states
. But the evil and falsity present
 in all the ruling loves surged up
ward against the appearance of Divine Truth.
 It
 rose
 in
 order
 to reach it, but could
 not reach
 it. It fell back and s
ank to
 the lowest regions. Now
, when
 it had fallen from the interior, it
 divided into three parts
.

**¶14.**
 The first part fell upon
 the hered
itary cycle; another part fell into the
 natural mind; another part fell into the
 collective evil of the proprium. Through
 the portion
 that fell
 upon the hereditary cycle, a binding
 connection was established in the perceptions and
 the
 natural affections. Therefore
, because
 of this, inherited
 dispositions received dominion and became rulers
 over the five kinds of natural affection
 and the five kinds of perception.


**¶15.** Through the
 evil
 nature that descended upon the hereditary cycle
, a connection was bound
 into the perceptions. Also
, through the perverted spiritual formations that
 were
 cast down upon
 the natural mind, another
 connection was bound into the natural affections
.

**¶16.**
 Therefore
, because
 of this, hereditary dispositions and
 inherited tendencies received domin
ion over the perceptions and the natural
 affections:
 through the root of self-derived evil
 that fell
 from above, and through the root
 of perverted formations that were ab
orted there
 and
 fell
 into
 the natural mind.

**¶
17.** However
, the other channels that
 the Divine established in the natural mind —
 those
 through which the living essence of the fundamental
 spiritual substances ascends to
 the interior states — these channels are not
 bound
 to the hereditary cycle. Rather,
 they are seized and
 plundered by the forces attached to
 the hereditary cycle, that
 hang parasitically from it.


**¶18.** Just
 as you have instruct
ed us and
 assembled
 this
 teaching
:
 you have told us about
 the pattern
 of the channels
 of influx.
 The
 first
 is
 the one
 that comes from the intermediate
 rational states to
 the natural
 mind,
 and the one
 that comes from the hered
itary cycle to the collective
 evil of the proprium —
 that
 is one
.
 The second connection
 is the one that comes from the doc
trinal forms to
 the per
ceptions.
 The
 third is bound
 through
 the perv
erted formations
 into
 the natural aff
ections;
 also
 in
 these
 aff
ections the
 spiritual
 origins of the perv
erted formations who
 d
well in the interior
 states are bound and
 intertwined…


**¶20
.** You
 have inqu
ired about this
 teaching
 in
 its
 excellence
. The natural
 mind, from which abundant living essence asc
ends — the Divine has drawn forth
 these channels. He has fast
ened them from the interior
 fac
ulties and bound them into the natural states
. These are the foundational connections of
 the entire governing order
, through which the life of the living
 soul is drawn
 up
ward —
 ascending
 from the whole
 natural mind, from all
 the elevated states of worship, from every
 productive state of use, and from all
 the isolated truths set apart.


**¶21.** After
 that first great connection is
 the connection of the perceptions, which
 is bound to the doctrinal forms
 and the structures of understanding
 in the interior.
 For through these also a great abundance of
 living essence ascends from every perception and
 from the entire state of spiritual trial,
 being drawn upward from them to the
 interior like a vast multitude.


**¶22.** What
,
 however
, is lesser…
 of
 their
 channel
… The perceptions are present throughout the
 entire natural mind, whether in
 small or great degree
; but the connection of
 the rational faculty is not present throughout the
 entire natural mind — only in the state
 of clear intellectual light. Therefore
 even
 now
, the natural affections do not extend
 throughout the whole
 of
 that
 illumin
ated
 state; there is only a small part
 of them in the
 higher
 regions of that state of light…


**¶23.** I
 have instruct
ed you about the found
ational connections:
 I
 have taught
 you that they are bound by
 their
 roots
 to one another.
 They stir one another, they
 draw living
 essence from one another,
 through
 the activity of the interior spiritual faculties
, which stirs the nature dwelling in
 them all.

**¶24
.** Now
,
 when the evil
 and falsity present within them
 is finally broken and stripped of its power
, then that evil also
 will turn upon its own members
 and overt
urn them, and they will rage against
 one another and
 st
ir one another to
 destruction
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There are three conduits that exist through the entire zone, from the abyss to its heights.
For when the Father of Life constructed the heavenly worlds, he divested them of their bodies, [he] threw them to the earths below.

So, the upper worlds are of the soul and the spirit; but the worlds below are of the body and the carcass [of what is above.] Now as for this, he [took the image of] the powers of heaven; he sealed it on their bodies and their carcasses that are on the earths, so that when life comes up from the fullness of these earths, it can be entirely drawn up to the heights in the roots of what is heavenly, that are fastened in their bodies. And also, all life can be purified in that place.

However, the waste that will be swept from the purified one who ascends to the heights will be let fall to the ground through the conduits of these conduits, and will be poured down [to the depths] and thrown to the underside.

This is the first conduit, which comes from the powers of the heavens to their bodies and their carcasses that are upon the earth; also, from their bodies and [their] carcasses that are on the earths to the powers of the heavens.

The second conduit is the one that comes from the temples and dwellings and cities that exist in the heavens down to the ground, to the five shapes of tree that grow upon the earth. The life comes up from the trees to the temples and cities. Life too, and the residue of the heavenly ones, comes down to the trees in a conduit.

And the third conduit is all the powers and householders who dwell in all the firmaments, whose roots come down from them to the five worlds of flesh that creep upon the earth, being fixed to one another. Now, the power and the life that shall be gathered in from the worlds of flesh are dispersed among them in various shapes. The powers above shall draw them to the upper side through conduits.

[The was]te too, and the lust and the evil-doing and the anger that will be greater in the powers of [heave]n, shall be poured to the ground through their various conduits. They shall be discharged upon mankind and the other remaining animals. When what is heavenly will wash the waste and the stench and the poison down on the creations of the flesh below, in their turn the creations shall be greater in lust and anger and evil-doing against each other through the action of their fathers who are on high.

Still, look at the wheel of the stars! It has no [root in this earth], but its roots are bound in the totality. The wheel of stars, then, receives life through the power and the life that ascend from the earths through conduits and the firmaments above. It (also) takes life from those conduits that receive up to the firmaments and the heavenly worlds above it, it takes life out from that place.

Look, in that the wheel has no root in this earth, from where did the stars and signs of the zodiac find this authority? They became masters over these five fleshes and five trees. Even though you have told us that the wheel has no root there! For you said to us that every thing, if it can be reduced from the earth, the heavenly powers above draw it through a conduit. Also, we see that every thing that a person will attain, whether it be wealth that comes into his possession or poverty that will accrue to him, or his sickness and health; he attains it through the signs of the zodiac and the star under which he shall be born.

Nevertheless, what I proclaimed to you, namely that the wheel has no root therein, I have recounted to you properly. It is set aright in its position. For when the Living Spirit, the Father of Life, constructed the heavens and the firmaments above, he bound their roots into the earths below; in their carcasses that he had stripped from them. Yet, when he constructed the wheel, [he] did not bind its root into the earths, but he bound the root of the wheel by the sea giant.

And when [the] Ambassador came, he displayed his image and purified and brought the light out from all [the] heavens. Matter, however, which is present in all the rulers, spurted out against the image of the Ambassador. It went up in order to reach it, but reached it not. It dropped back and fell to the [under]side. Now, when it had fallen from above, it separated out into three parts.

The first part fell to the wheel; another part fell to the earth; an[other part fell to the se]a. [By means] of the part that fell to the sphere, [the r]oot was bound in the trees and flesh. Therefore, because of this, they received authority and became masters in the five worlds of the flesh and the five worlds of the tree.
Through the nature that came down [upo]n the wheel the root was bound in the trees. Also, by means of the abortions that came to the ground, another root was bound in the fleshes.

Therefore, because of this, the stars and signs of the zodiac received authority over the trees and the fleshes: through the root of Sin that fell down; and [the ro]ot of the abortions that were aborted there, they fell to the ground.

However, the[se] other conduits that [the] Living Spirit has bound in the e[a]rths, they that the soul of the elements comes up through to the heavens; those (conduits) are not bound to the wheel. Rather, they are plundered from them by the powers on the wheel, that hang from it.

Just as you have instructed us and put together this lesson on [these conduits:] you have told us about the prototype of the conduits. The first is the one that comes from the firmaments to the earths, and the one that comes from the wheel to the sea giant. That is only one. So, the other root is the one that comes [fr]om [the temples] to the trees. The third is bound by means of the abortions in the f[leshes]; also in the fleshes the fathers of the abortions who are in the heavens [above them] are bound and twined, and the[y] that [dwell above are fastened to them.]

You have inquired about a [great matter,] and you have asked about this lesson in superiority, great [is] the earth from which much life ascends[. For] the Father of Life has drawn them. He has fastened them from the powers [above, and] he has bound them in the earths. (These conduits) are the roots of the ent[ire] ruling-power that the life of the living soul is drawn up through, it coming up from the whole earth, from all the mountains, fields and islands.

After that first great root is the root of the trees, which is bound to the temples and the buildings above. For there also is much great life coming up from the tree and the entire Cross, being drawn up from them to the upper side like a great host.

What, however, is lesser [is the third root. By means] of their conduit[s,] he takes up [life from] the roots [that are bound in] the earths, they [that are spread through] the whole earth in all the worlds. Again, these of the trees are present in the whole earth, whether small or great; but the root of mankind [below] is not present in the whole earth, other than only this world of the south. Therefore, even now these fleshes do not make [their dwelling] in the entire world of the south[, but] there is a small part of them in [the heights] of the upper side of the world of the south in [lesser part] in number than the [trees.]

I have instructed you about the roots [of all of] them, [I] have taught you that they are bound by their [roots, each one] with one another. They stir one another, they draw life from one another through the action of the powers above, which stirs the nature that dwells in them all.

Now, when the Matter that is in them will be crushed and despoiled, then that Matter too shall [turn upon] its members and overturn them and [rage against] each other [and] stir [one another to destruction.]

The first conduit is the root of all the powers above, they that exist in all the heavens. They are cast off and fettered on the earths below; because the earth below is the ‘stripping off’, the garment and the body of the powers that are above the heavens.
